en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large mural or wall painting set within a vaulted interior. The scene depicts a crowded Renaissance gathering with nobles, townspeople, children and dogs in front of a cityscape with towers in the background. The mural is framed by ornate architectural details above a decorated wooden panel and a pointed doorway. German caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.
